online.blurb: A fully online hackathon on housing. Join a live expert panel and a Google AI Studio + Cloud Run workshop, co-broadcast with GDG Annapolis and GDG Baltimore, then build with a team. All levels welcome, no coding experience required. Projects compete against chapters across the Northeast, judged by an expert panel in January. Free. Bring a laptop and a Google account.

online.title: GDG Annapolis: AI for Good Hackathon - Innovating for Housing
online.where: AACC CALT Building, Arnold, MD, US
online.blurb: Join the AI for Good Hackathon to tackle the housing crisis with AI-driven solutions. Open to all skill levels, it features a workshop, panel, and project showcase at the Innovation Summit. Ideal for developers, designers, and advocates. Participate locally and compete across Northeast GDG chapters. RSVP to contribute!

online.title: Introduction to Agent Development Kit (ADK) Workshop
online.registration: Free registration with Bevy Virtual Conference
online.blurb: Join an interactive workshop to explore the Agent Development Kit (ADK). Developers can learn to build and deploy efficient multi-agent systems, including a research assistant that analyzes data and generates reports. Enhance your agentic workflows and expand your skills. Reserve your spot now!
